scripts.build:ci: if [ "$CF_PAGES_BRANCH" = "main" ]; then npm run worker:deploy; else npm run worker:deploy:preview; fi && npm run build
scripts.pages:deploy: BRANCH="${CF_PAGES_BRANCH:-$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)}"; if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then npm run worker:deploy; else npm run worker:deploy:preview; fi && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare --branch "$BRANCH"
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply preferans-db --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply preferans-db-preview --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply preferans-db --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
